citations.title: Reykjavík: Whales & Northern Lights | Whale Safari - Closer to Nature
citations.content:
This magnificent combo tour unites some of the most popular winter attractions in Iceland!

Duration: Approx. 5-7 hrs. total Available: 1 September - 15 April Departures: 1-30 September at 09:00 or 13:00 and 22:00 1 October - 30 November at 09:00 or 13:00 and 21:00 1 December - 31 January at 13:00 and 21:00 1 February - 14 March at 09:00 or 13:00 and 21:00 15 March - 15 April at 09:00 or 13:00 and 22:00

You start the day with a 3 hr. whale watching tour at 09:00 or 13:00 (see calendar for availability) with departure from the Old Harbour in Reykjavík. The most common species seen in Faxaflói bay in winter are the minke whales, dolphins, porpoises and humpback whales. The views and landscape on the horizon are not to be missed as they are astonishing in the winter glow! If no wildlife is spotted on the tour, we offer a free ticket to try again! Check our Whale diary for details on past sightings and information about future tours.
